subject: Audit evidence export — sample formats & timezone handling
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit evidence export — sample formats & timezone handling

Hi Sarah,

Great to speak earlier — quick recap and next steps from our call: 

- Scope: Export of "who accessed what/when" for API-driven requests against MediQ's tenant. You confirmed the primary need is a per-request audit trail for the last 90 days, with a producible sample for legal & security review.
- Format request: You mentioned CSV as the minimal deliverable and Parquet for analytic ingestion. We'll produce both, plus a small compressed sample (<=10MB) for review.
- Fields: We captured user identifier (you asked for hashed PII), resource path, operation, timestamp, request_id, and any matched model version.
- Timezone: You asked that timestamps be normalized to UTC and include an original-local offset column.
- Redaction/hashing: We'll provide a column with SHA-256 hashes for user_id and a redacted display field; raw PII will never be exported.
- Chain of custody: You requested a manifest with SHA-256 checksums for delivered files and a short delivery note.

Action items we committed to:
1) Produce a CSV + Parquet sample export (prod-like subset) and a schema file by EOD 10/06.
2) Include hashing/redaction notes and sample SQL to load the export into Postgres.
3) Confirm retention window (you said 90 days) and whether you need HSM-signed checksums.

Attachments: postcall-notes-20261005.pdf (notes + sample column list).

Could you confirm the final column set below and whether the 90-day retention is firm? Once you confirm I'll assign the export task to Ben and share the sample link.

Proposed column set (CSV): timestamp_utc,timestamp_local,timezone_offset,request_id,user_hash,user_display,resource,operation,model_version,response_size_bytes,tenant_id

Thanks,
Ro

Ro Mehta
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@mediqhealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T18:47:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence export — sample formats & timezone handling

Thanks Ro — appreciate the recap. Quick confirmations and clarifications from our side:

- Retention: 90 days is correct for our initial ask. We may request a 1-year export for legal review later, but start with 90 days.
- Column set: the proposed list looks good. A couple of must-haves for our compliance checklist:
  * user_hash must be salted before hashing (we can share a salt or you can include a per-tenant salt column).
  * Include an "actor_type" column (system, end_user, admin) so we can filter system automation vs human access.
  * Please include an "audit_reason" free-text column where available (e.g., "manual-override", "model-inference").
- Formats: CSV for legal + Parquet for analytics is ideal. Please compress samples as .gz or .snappy.
- Timezones: normalize to UTC. We need both timestamp_utc and the original timestamp_local (ISO8601 including offset).
- Delivery: We prefer a Drive link + signed manifest (SHA-256). HSM-signed checksums are not required for now, but we will note if we escalate.

Attaching the compliance_req_v2.docx with our internal column mapping and examples.

If you can deliver the sample by EOD tomorrow (10/06) that would let our security team review ahead of the exec sync next week.

Regards,
Sarah Jones
Legal & Compliance Lead | MediQ Health
sarah.jones@mediqhealth.com

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence export — sample formats & timezone handling

Thanks Sarah — that helps. A few notes and our proposed delivery plan: 

- Salted hashing: we'll generate a per-tenant salt and include the salt column encrypted in the manifest (not in the CSV). If you prefer to supply a salt, we can accept that via a secure upload — let me know.
- Actor_type and audit_reason: will include both columns. If some rows don't have audit_reason we will fill with NULL.
- Sample size & scope: Ben will produce a 5k-line CSV sample (compressed) representing a cross-section of API/request types (auth, inference, admin). We'll also include a tiny Parquet sample and the schema JSON.
- Load hints: we'll include a small README with SQL COPY and an example Postgres table DDL.
- Checksums: manifest with SHA-256 for each delivered file. HSM options noted for later.

Schedule:
- 10/06 17:00 ET: Deliver sample CSV + Parquet + schema + manifest to the Drive folder in the thread link.
- 10/07: Follow-up call to review sample and discuss retention automation and audit tooling.

Ben — assigning export build to you. Please use the prod-like subset Ben suggested on call unless Sarah requests staging-only data.

Ro

--
On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 6:47 PM Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@mediqhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ro — appreciate the recap...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence export — sample formats & timezone handling

Got it — I'll stand up the export job this morning and push a gzipped sample to the Drive folder by the 17:00 ET target. Couple of clarifications for prod-like sampling: 

1) Do you want PII-sanitized sample (preferred) or a synthetic mapping of IDs? We can do either; sanitized means real events but with hashed user ids.
2) For model_version we will include both the deployed tag and the inference runtime (e.g., v1.3 / runtime-202609). OK?

Sarah — if you prefer staging-only rows for privacy while reviewing, say so and we'll cut staging. Otherwise we'll use a low-risk prod slice (non-PHI endpoints only).

Ben
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
